Helicopter UH-1H 66-17027

Unit: 50 MED DET
Incident number: 680212211ACD
Date: 02/12/1968
MIA-POW file reference number: 1046
Number killed in accident = 4
Accident Summary: The flight never arrived; searchers found no trace of the aircraft or of its crew.
REFNO Synopsis: MIA file extract. Summary: On February 12, 1968 the helicopter left on a night flight to Ban Me Thuot and was not heard from again. A later report said it crashed in the hills west of the city; no remains were recovered.
